children: Tesla plans to phase down Cybertruck production at its Texas plant around mid-2027 to expand Cybercab output. Prices now range from $82,490 to $102,490; paid Cybercab rides have begun in Austin.
Tesla’s U.S. Cybertruck sales fell 48% to 20,237 in 2025, from 38,965 in 2024, per Kelley Blue Book. Tesla has issued 11 recalls since deliveries began in late 2023.
Scottish Mortgage sold its Tesla stake in April, ending a position held since 2013. The nearly $470 million investment generated almost $6.2 billion in profit, about 13 times its cost.
Tesla (TSLA) says Cybercab production capacity exceeds 125,000 units. Texas records show about 570 of the state’s 1,200-plus robotaxis are Cybercabs; most others are Model Ys.
Tesla (TSLA) will enter Argentina on Nov. 20, 2026, marking its launch in the market.
- Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) told customers in Australia and New Zealand who had reserved Cybertrucks that the vehicles would not be delivered and that their deposits would be refunded.
Ross Gerber called Tesla’s Cybertruck plans “another failure,” questioned Full Self-Driving’s readiness for Cybercab, and challenged the robotaxi business’s profitability.
Jason Calacanis said he is putting every spare dollar he can find into eight stocks, including Tesla, Inc. (TSLA), following the technology-stock selloff after the 2026 midterm elections.
